h3_prompt_fixtures.note: Frozen in #179. Do not refresh to hide a prompt change. Protected fused videos are out of this tree.

availability.note: available includes executable and requires_navigation so other Labs stay visible. blocked includes blocked and needs_data with reasons.

wizard_context.note: Availability is derived from the capability registry, current tab, labs snapshot and pending questions.

known_gaps.summary: Addressed: model_for_manifest keeps fused IDs; references resolve to minimax_h3_ref2va_fused_turbo and frames stay minimax_h3_fused_turbo. Runtime send uses the same helper.
Addressed: seriesProviderMatchesGlobal compares writingBaseUrl, flowShift, audioShift and modelProfile; Setup and the Lab effect share seriesProviderFieldsFromProfile.

Addressed: bulkApproveSelections with replaceFinals false keeps valid finals. UI pending takes and Wizard all_latest use that policy; replace_latest and explicit selected_latest remain the replace paths.
Addressed: review_series_attempts keeps attempt_id only on selected_latest with exactly one shot_number and explicitAttemptSelection picks that historical take, not the latest take of shot N.
Addressed: update_series_episode annotates stale/conflict shots; render refuses them; an explicit syncShotDialogueFromScript operation updates beats without dropping historical attempts.
Addressed: wizardContext derives executable / needs_data / blocked / requires_navigation from the registry.
Addressed: stageSeriesComic is exposed as stage_series_comic on the existing Series comic handoff.
Addressed: episode creation may approve only a brand-new canon base from the same request, never pending canon on an existing series.
Addressed: open_story_section resolves a visible tab or explains incompatibility; it never claims an invisible tab opened.
Addressed: exclusive aria-pressed modes; storyRecipeRequiresVisualIdentities is true only for image_guided. Technical blockers stay visible in automatic workflow.
Series voice bible fields persist but do not change the inspected H3 shot prompt.
Addressed: StoryMusicSettingsBar names ACE, MiniMax Music 3 local and MiniMax API from the effective model, not isLocalMusicModel.
Addressed: runtime adapt_clip_plans_for_h3 now passes effective policy; ref2va quote path uses models-safe language tags. Default remains native when omitted.
Addressed: plan vs send recorded on existing Director provenance fields; quoted 'Qué silencio' is dialogue, not a mute order.
Addressed: Creative extra lines come from the LLM transport, not a canned post-LLM sentence. Faithful and 'only these lines' keep extras out.

operations.user_operation: Manage mouth collections and apply them to characters
operations.control: Ask to the Wizard → Lips Creator
operations.preconditions: Exact workspace and IDs; revisions for edits; reviewed mouths before apply
operations.persistence: Workspace Lips Creator library with compare-and-swap revisions and mutation receipts
operations.notes: MCP uses the same collection commands. Generation runs sequentially through the native image queue and keeps candidates pending.

operations.user_operation: Generate missing or selected mouth candidates
operations.control: Ask to the Wizard → Lips Creator
operations.preconditions: Exact saved pack ID; installed compatible image model and explicit generation intent
operations.persistence: Workspace Lips Creator library with compare-and-swap revisions and mutation receipts
operations.notes: MCP uses the same collection commands. Generation runs sequentially through the native image queue and keeps candidates pending.

operations.user_operation: Search the Video 3D shot library and apply an exact id
operations.control: Ask to the Wizard → Video 3D
operations.preconditions: An exact template id, or a query whose top card outranks the next; object ids for binds; base_revision for patches
operations.persistence: Workspace world3d-edits working copy and a published .world3d.scene.json
operations.notes: MCP, the Wizard and the production planner share the editor catalog. A tie or an unknown id does not invent a scene.
